chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Al-Reza (peace be upon him) who said:
Eating the broad-beans enhances the two thighs, and gives birth to the fresh blood.

key_terms.يُمَخِّخُ: Strengthens or makes robust (specifically referring to the thighs/muscles)

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating broad beans according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) highlights the physiological benefits of broad beans, noting they strengthen the thighs and generate fresh blood. This reflects the Shia tradition of integrating practical health advice with spiritual teachings, emphasizing the body as an amanah (trust) to be maintained through proper nutrition. The mention of 'fresh blood' underscores the bean's role in vitality and physical robustness within Islamic dietary law.
